package.description: The next generation desktop softphone app for FreePBX and PBXact!

en-US.description: The next generation desktop softphone app for FreePBX and PBXact!
en-US.longDescription:
Meet the next generation desktop softphone app for FreePBX and PBXact!
The Sangoma Phone desktop client combines the best of our existing solutions with new core technology, providing a great communications experience for calling and collaborating with coworkers.
Release of these MacOS and Windows apps offer these features:
- Send/Receive calls
- Blind transfers
- Call Log
- Visual Voicemail
- Favorite Contacts with search option
- Presence
- Chat option (one to one, Public or Private group)
- Conference call
en-US.name: Sangoma Phone

zh-CN.description: 下一代 FreePBX 和 PBXact 桌面软电话应用！
zh-CN.longDescription:
欢迎体验专为 FreePBX 和 PBXact 打造的下一代桌面软电话应用！
Sangoma Phone 桌面客户端融合了我们现有解决方案的精华与全新核心技术，为您带来卓越的通话及团队协作通信体验。
全新发布的 MacOS 和 Windows 版本具备以下功能：
- 拨打/接听电话
- 盲转呼叫
- 通话记录查询
- 可视化语音信箱
- 支持搜索的常用联系人
- 在线状态显示
- 即时通讯功能（一对一、公开群组或私密群组）
- 电话会议
